author: reviewer
excerpt: The value on the left side of the graph represents the average measurement of the displayed metric over a certain period.
observation: Re-fetched Oura Member Care 'Using Trends' (last updated October 14, 2026); the hash matches E-009. The larger value at the top left is the most current data; the smaller value on the left side of the graph is an average over a period: 90 days in Day view, and 'since the beginning of your data' in Week, Month and Year views.
limitations: Vendor help text, not observed in the app. Does not describe a per-week average of sleep hours, how the week is defined, missing-night handling, or any week-over-week change display.
